{{Infobox Ability |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= [[File:BotW Woodcutting.png|320x320px]] |Screenshot TotK= {{Please Upload|File:TotK Woodcutting.png}} }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |req= |uses= Chopping down [[Tree]]s |comp= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Woodcutting||Series, TotK}} is a recurring ability in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|TotK}} Woodcutting goes unnamed in {{BotW}}. ==Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Woodcutting can be performed by attacking [[Tree]]s with either a [[One-Handed Weapon|One-Handed]] or [[Two-Handed Weapon]] that is sharp. [[Axe]]s are the most effective [[Weapon]]s. Doing so enough times will cause the Tree to break into a [[Log]] and fall in the opposite direction of [[Link]]. [[Palm Tree]]s break into unique Logs known as [[Palm-Tree Log]]s. Attacking Logs further will split them into several pieces of [[Wood]]. Prior to completing all four [[Ancient Shrine]]s on the [[Great Plateau]], Link can encounter the [[Old Man]] cutting down a [[Cedar Tree]] near his [[Old Man's Cabin|Cabin]]. When asked about what he is doing, the Old Man explains that he wanted to collect Wood from it. Since controlling where Logs fall can be difficult, he advises Link to face in the direction he wants it to land while Woodcutting. If Link has a [[Woodcutter's Axe]] in his [[Inventory]], the Old Man will then invite him to take over Woodcutting while he takes a break. During the night, the Old Man stops Woodcutting so he can rest at a nearby [[Campfire]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Like in {{BotW}}, [[Link]] can Woodcut by attacking a [[Tree]] with a sharp [[Weapon]], with [[Axe]]s being particularly effective. Trees in the [[Depths]] are also capable of producing [[Log]]s when attacked. Additionally, Woodcutting is the method by which [[Evermean]]s can be defeated. On the [[Great Sky Island]], a [[Maker Construct]] can be found cutting down Trees southwest of the [[Ukouh Shrine]]. When approached by Link, it asks if he has come to Woodcut as well. It then explains the process of Woodcutting to him, as well as several ways to use Logs. The Maker Construct also allows Link to use a nearby [[Stone Axe]] if he is interested in Woodcutting. Should Link chop down a Tree in front of this [[Construct]], it will commend his form and ask for his assistance. After the [[Time Bell]] rings at 7:00 PM, it stops Woodcutting for the day and proceeds to rest at a nearby charging spot. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== * {{Term|Series|Log|link}} * {{Term|Series|Lumberjack|link}} * {{Term|Series|Woodcutter's Axe|link}} * {{Term|Series|Woodcutter's Discipline|link}} {{Ref| {{Cite|[What are you doing?] I thought this tree here would make for some good firewood.
